scenarios.name: Reduce the full ribbon to compact group buttons

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is open in the MCAD Software
the View ribbon tab displays its full groups of commands
the user opens the ribbon display menu
Minimize to Panel Buttons is selected
the user dismisses the menu with Escape
the full View ribbon remains visible
the user activates the ribbon display control once
the View ribbon shows compact buttons for Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate
the viewport has more vertical space
the user selects the Windows group button
a temporary panel displays that group's commands
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the full View ribbon is restored
